description: This file contains the implementation of the SparkConnectService class for Apache Spark, which manages gRPC server setup, request handling, and service lifecycle events for Spark Connect. It defines service methods, server initialization, and event posting related to Spark Connect.

classes.name: SparkConnectService
classes.description: Implementation of the gRPC service for Spark Connect, handling request processing, server binding, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: SparkConnectService$
classes.description: Singleton object managing the Spark Connect server instance, lifecycle events, and configuration.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectServiceStarted
classes.description: Event indicating the Spark Connect service has started and is ready.

classes.name: SparkListenerConnectServiceEnd
classes.description: Event indicating the Spark Connect service has shut down.

methods.name: executePlan
methods.description: Handles execution plan requests, delegating to SparkConnectExecutePlanHandler.

methods.name: analyzePlan
methods.description: Handles plan analysis requests, delegating to SparkConnectAnalyzeHandler.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Handles configuration update/fetch requests, delegating to SparkConnectConfigHandler.

methods.name: addArtifacts
methods.description: Handles artifact addition requests, returning a StreamObserver for streaming responses.

methods.name: artifactStatus
methods.description: Handles requests for artifact status, delegating to SparkConnectArtifactStatusesHandler.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Handles interruption requests for running executions.

methods.name: reattachExecute
methods.description: Handles reattachment of execute plans for ongoing executions.

methods.name: fetchErrorDetails
methods.description: Handles requests to fetch error details.

methods.name: methodWithCustomMarshallers
methods.description: Creates method descriptors with custom marshallers based on recursion limit.

methods.name: bindService
methods.description: Binds the service methods with custom marshallers for gRPC server.
